context:
Goal: a held card reads clearly, with one word for one thing.
Problem (goal): you chose one word only for a held card, but no question yet asks which word stays, "held" or "Suspense", so the build cannot start; only you pick the word.
Based on (ruling): your 2026-11-19 19:28 CST answer on the held-words question: one word only (filed in docs/decisions/duo-card-in-hand.md).
Based on (read): the built Card in Hand screen says "1 held" on the card line and titles the box "Suspense".
Departs from: main uses both words, held for a card's state and Suspense for the place — this picks one word for both.
Waiting on: your answer; the how-far-it-reaches question waits on this word.

options.gain: One short word you already see on the card line.
options.how: The box title and place name become held; Suspense goes away.
options.label: Held, everywhere
options.lose: The box and its title change from Suspense to a held word.

options.how: The card line, chip, offer and Post button say Suspense; held goes away.

options.lose: The card line changes from 1 held to a Suspense word.

reply: You chose a, held is the one word everywhere (2026-11-21 19:54 CST). Filed in git. The coordinator files the ruling and starts the lane. Item 97 still asks how far the change reaches. 19:57 CST.
short: Which one word: held or Suspense
